blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `listStoreCreditAccounts` method. This belongs to the Store Credit Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method retrieves a paginated list of store credit accounts based on optional filters and configuration.

To retrieve a list of store credit accounts by customer:

```ts
const accounts = await storeCreditModuleService.listStoreCreditAccounts({
  id: ["sca_123", "sca_321"],
})
```

children.name: debits

children.description: The current balance of this account (credits minus debits).
